# H38 Office MCP Server

> Machine-readable capability doc for AI assistants connecting to the H38
> Business Office via MCP.

## Endpoint

`https://jqukmwtsgcsaruucnqja.supabase.co/functions/v1/h38-mcp-server`

## Protocol

MCP streamable HTTP = JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTPS POST.

- `POST` the JSON-RPC body to the endpoint above.
- Header: `Authorization: Bearer <H38_MCP_API_KEY>`, `Content-Type: application/json`.
- Handshake: `initialize` → `notifications/initialized` → `tools/list` → `tools/call`.
- `GET` returns server info (no auth needed).

## Auth

One API key per business. The key is SHA-256 hashed server-side and matched
against `business_records` (collection `mcp_api_keys`); the matching row's
`business_id` scopes every query. Invalid/missing key → JSON-RPC error -32001.

## Data model

The Office is local-first. Server-side canonical store is `business_records`
with collections. Payload fields use Title Case With Spaces.

- **customers**: `Customer ID` (key), `Customer Name`, `Email`, `Phone`, `Status`
- **jobs**: `Job ID` (key), `Job Number`, `Project Title`, `Status`, `Customer ID`, `Due Date`, `Scheduled Date`
- **quotes**: `Quote ID` (key), `Quote Number`, `Project Title`, `Customer ID`, `Customer Name`, `Status` (Draft/Presented/Accepted), `Total`, `lines[]`
- **invoices**: `Invoice ID` (key), `Invoice Number`, `Customer ID`, `Job ID`, `Status` (Draft/Paid/...), `Total`, `Balance`, `Due Date`
- **timeEntries**: `Time Entry ID` (key), `Job ID`, `Hours`, `Notes`, `Start Time`, `Status`

## Tools

### list_customers {search?, status?, limit?}
Search customers by name. Status values like `Active`.

### get_customer {customer_id!}
Returns customer plus their jobs, quotes, invoices.

### list_jobs {status?, limit?}
Status values like `Scheduled`, `In Progress`, `Complete`.

### get_job {job_id!}
Returns job plus related quotes and time entries.

### create_quote {customer_id!, project_title!, items[]!, confirmed=false}
items[]: {description!, quantity=1, unit="each", unit_price!}.
Two-phase: without `confirmed:true` returns a preview with computed total.
With `confirmed:true` creates a Draft quote (owner review required before presenting).

### list_quotes {status?, limit?}
Status: `Draft`, `Presented`, `Accepted`.

### get_schedule {date=YYYY-MM-DD(today), days=1}
Jobs whose Due/Scheduled Date falls in [date, date+days).

### create_invoice {customer_id!, job_id?, amount?, title?, due_days=30, confirmed=false}
Two-phase like create_quote. If job_id given and amount omitted, uses the
job's accepted quote total. Creates Draft invoice.

### list_invoices {status="all"|"Paid"|"Draft"|"unpaid"|"overdue", limit?}
`overdue`/`unpaid` computed from Balance > 0 and Due Date < today.

### log_time {job_id!, hours!, notes?, date=today, confirmed=false}
Two-phase like create_quote. Records a time entry on the job.

## Conventions

- IDs shown to users are the record keys (`Customer ID`, `Job ID`, ...),
  e.g. `H38-CUST-NORTHERN-LAKES`, `QUOTE-...`, `INV-...`.
- Money: numbers, 2-decimal dollars.
- Dates: `YYYY-MM-DD`; datetimes: ISO-8601 UTC.
- Errors come back as a normal `tools/call` result with `isError: true`
  and human-readable text — surface the message, don't retry blindly.
- Never invent IDs. Always `list_*`/`get_*` first to resolve the real one.
